cond_0001.intro: The Network Analyst role is to ensure the stability and integrity of the university's network. This is achieved by assisting in the planning, designing, and developing LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP across the organization. In addition, the Analyst will participate with the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network / telecommunication hardware, software, and communication links. This individual will also analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion. The position reports to the Manager of Network and Telecommunication Services.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Ensure network stability and monitor network regularly.
Prepare and maintain networking documentation network and cabling layouts.
Troubleshoot and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VOIP and VPN related problems.
Cooperate with management to develop staff and improve their skills.
Respond to Help Desk telephone calls, emails, and personnel requests for technical support in a timely and courteous manner.
Maintain an inventory of network /telecommunication property and assets.
Provide technical support and monitors day to day operations of the network infrastructure.
Maintain quality service by following organization standards.
Report on network operational status by gathering, prioritizing information; managing projects.
Analyzes university needs regarding use of network and telecommunication equipment and services, and provides planning, leadership, direction, and technical expertise to the campus on LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP services.
Participates in strategic and long-range planning for campus network and telecommunication services.
Provides Manager with appropriate updates detailing progress made on assigned tasks, projects and break/fix problems.
Notify manager of any problems encountered or anticipated with the tasks assigned and keeps manager informed of the estimated time required to complete each task.
Maintains currency of knowledge with respect to relevant state-of-the-art technology, equipment and/or systems.
Provides technical oversight and assignment, supervision, and review of work performed by student employees.
Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Works with internal customers and external suppliers.
Participates in technical group discussions and presentations.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate degree or 2-5 years of experience in networking and telecommunication, or any equivalent combination of experience.
Knowledge of fundamental principles, methodologies and procedures utilized in administering and monitoring network and telecommunication procedures.
Experience in network, systems and data security; knowledge of various security tools and equipment used to secure networks, servers, and data; proven experience in following standards and processes for a secure computing environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, problem solving ability, interpersonal skills, presentation skills, and the ability to use software tools to develop effective and professional documents.
Must be able to work with people at all levels of the organization, manage multiple initiatives with deadlines, respond quickly to new changing situations and work well under pressure while maintaining individual and team effectiveness.
Ability to maintain confidential data in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Willingness to work as a contributing member of the team including other systems personnel, the operations staff, and the account administrators.
Knowledge of: Routing and Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRFs, etc.), Switching (VLANs, Trunking, Spanning Tree, etc.), Aruba Wireless Network, VoIP/SIP, SD-WAN, SASE, Firewalls.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree.
Technical degree in management information systems, computer technology, computer science or related field.
Firewalls (Palo Alto).

cond_0009.intro: The Network Analyst works with the team to ensure the stability and integrity of the university's network. This is achieved by collaborating on the planning, designing, and developing LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP across the organization. The Analyst will also participate with the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network and telecommunication hardware, software, and communication links, and will work alongside colleagues to analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion. Off-hour and weekend work will be required to respond to critical network problems and modifications. The position reports to the Manager of Network and Telecommunication Services.
cond_0009.responsibilities:
Specific responsibilities include accountability for the following groups/areas:
Help ensure network stability and monitor the network regularly.
Prepare and maintain networking documentation, network and cabling layouts.
Coordinate with colleagues to troubleshoot and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VOIP and VPN related problems.
Work with management to develop staff and support improvement of their skills.
Respond to Help Desk telephone calls, emails, and personnel requests for technical support in a timely and courteous manner.
Maintain an inventory of network and telecommunication property and assets.
Provide technical support and assist in monitoring day to day operations of the network infrastructure.
Help maintain quality service by following organization standards.
Share updates on network operational status by gathering and prioritizing information; assist in managing projects.
Work alongside the team to analyze university needs regarding use of network and telecommunication equipment and services, and contribute planning, direction, and technical expertise to the campus on LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP services.
Participate in strategic and long-range planning for campus network and telecommunication services.
Keep the Manager informed with appropriate updates detailing progress made on assigned tasks, projects and break/fix problems.
Notify the manager of any problems encountered or anticipated with assigned tasks and share estimated time required to complete each task.
Maintain current knowledge of relevant technology, equipment and/or systems.
Provide technical oversight and support, and assist in reviewing work performed by student employees.
Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Work with internal customers and external suppliers.
Participate in technical group discussions and presentations.
cond_0009.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate degree or 2-5 years of experience in networking and telecommunication, or any equivalent combination of experience.
Knowledge of fundamental principles, methodologies and procedures utilized in administering and monitoring network and telecommunication procedures.
Experience in network, systems and data security; knowledge of various security tools and equipment used to secure networks, servers, and data; proven experience in following standards and processes for a secure computing environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, problem solving ability, interpersonal skills, presentation skills, and the ability to use software tools to develop effective and professional documents.
Ability to work with people at all levels of the organization, manage multiple initiatives with deadlines, respond quickly to changing situations and work well under pressure while maintaining individual and team effectiveness.
Ability to maintain confidential data in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Willingness to work as a contributing member of the team including other systems personnel, the operations staff, and the account administrators.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree.
Technical degree in management information systems, computer technology, computer science or related field.
Knowledge of Routing and Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRFs, etc.).
Knowledge of Switching (VLANs, Trunking, Spanning Tree, etc.).
Familiarity with Aruba Wireless Network.
Experience with VoIP/SIP.
Knowledge of SD-WAN and SASE.
Experience with Firewalls (Palo Alto preferred).

The Analyst will participate in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network and telecommunication hardware, software, and communication links. This individual will also analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion. Off-hour and weekend work will be required to respond to critical network problems and modifications. The position reports to the Manager of Network and Telecommunication Services.
cond_0070.responsibilities:
Specific responsibilities include accountability for the following groups/areas:
Ensure network stability and monitor the network on a scheduled basis. Prepare and maintain networking documentation, network and cabling layouts. Troubleshoot and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VOIP and VPN related problems. Support management efforts to develop staff skills. Handle Help Desk telephone calls, emails, and personnel requests for technical support in a timely and accurate manner. Maintain an inventory of network and telecommunication property and assets. Provide technical support and monitor day-to-day operations of the network infrastructure. Maintain quality service by following organization standards. Report on network operational status by gathering and prioritizing information and managing projects. Analyze university needs regarding use of network and telecommunication equipment and services, and provide planning, direction, and technical expertise on LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP services. Contribute to strategic and long-range planning for campus network and telecommunication services. Provide the Manager with updates detailing progress on assigned tasks, projects and break/fix problems. Notify the manager of problems encountered or anticipated with assigned tasks and keep the manager informed of estimated completion times. Maintain current knowledge of relevant technology, equipment and systems. Provide technical oversight and review of work performed by student employees. Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned. Coordinate with internal customers and external suppliers on specific tasks. Contribute input to technical group discussions and documentation.
cond_0070.requirements:
Associate degree is required or 2-5 years of experience in networking and telecommunication, or any equivalent combination of experience; Bachelor's degree is a plus.
Technical degree in management information systems, computer technology, computer science or related field preferred.
Knowledge of fundamental principles, methodologies and procedures utilized in administering and monitoring network and telecommunication procedures.
Experience in network, systems and data security is required; knowledge of various security tools and equipment used to secure networks, servers, and data is required; proven experience in following standards and processes for a secure computing environment.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting; problem solving ability, and the ability to use software tools to develop effective and professional documents required.
Must be able to work with people at all levels of the organization, manage multiple initiatives with deadlines, respond to changing situations and maintain individual and team effectiveness.
Ability to maintain confidential data in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Willingness to work as a contributing member of the team including other systems personnel, the operations staff, and the account administrators.
Knowledge of Routing and Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRFs, etc.)
Knowledge of Switching (VLANs, Trunking, Spanning Tree, etc.)
Knowledge of Aruba Wireless Network
Knowledge of VoIP/SIP
Knowledge of SD-WAN
Knowledge of SASE
Knowledge of Firewalls (Palo Alto preferred)
cond_0070.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.
cond_0070.inclusion: However you identify or whatever your path here, women are especially encouraged to apply if you see a position that makes your heart skip a beat. The Analyst will also participate with the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network and telecommunication hardware, software, and communication links, and will work alongside colleagues to analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion. Off-hour and weekend work will be required to respond to critical network problems and modifications. The position reports to the Manager of Network and Telecommunication Services.
cond_0153.responsibilities:
Specific responsibilities include accountability for the following groups/areas:
Help ensure network stability and monitor the network regularly.
Prepare and maintain networking documentation, network and cabling layouts.
Coordinate with colleagues to troubleshoot and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VOIP and VPN related problems.
Work with management to develop staff and support improvement of their skills.
Respond to Help Desk telephone calls, emails, and personnel requests for technical support in a timely and courteous manner.
Maintain an inventory of network and telecommunication property and assets.
Provide technical support and assist in monitoring day to day operations of the network infrastructure.
Help maintain quality service by following organization standards.
Share updates on network operational status by gathering and prioritizing information; assist in managing projects.
Work alongside the team to analyze university needs regarding use of network and telecommunication equipment and services, and contribute planning, direction, and technical expertise to the campus on LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP services.
Participate in strategic and long-range planning for campus network and telecommunication services.
Keep the Manager informed with appropriate updates detailing progress made on assigned tasks, projects and break/fix problems.
Notify the manager of any problems encountered or anticipated with assigned tasks and share estimated time required to complete each task.
Maintain current knowledge of relevant technology, equipment and/or systems.
Provide technical oversight and support, and assist in reviewing work performed by student employees.
Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Work with internal customers and external suppliers.
Participate in technical group discussions and presentations.
cond_0153.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate degree or 2-5 years of experience in networking and telecommunication, or any equivalent combination of experience.
Knowledge of fundamental principles, methodologies and procedures utilized in administering and monitoring network and telecommunication procedures.
Experience in network, systems and data security; knowledge of various security tools and equipment used to secure networks, servers, and data; proven experience in following standards and processes for a secure computing environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, problem solving ability, interpersonal skills, presentation skills, and the ability to use software tools to develop effective and professional documents.
Ability to work with people at all levels of the organization, manage multiple initiatives with deadlines, respond quickly to changing situations and work well under pressure while maintaining individual and team effectiveness.
Ability to maintain confidential data in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Willingness to work as a contributing member of the team including other systems personnel, the operations staff, and the account administrators.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree.
Technical degree in management information systems, computer technology, computer science or related field.
Knowledge of Routing and Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRFs, etc.).
Knowledge of Switching (VLANs, Trunking, Spanning Tree, etc.).
Familiarity with Aruba Wireless Network.
Experience with VoIP/SIP.
Knowledge of SD-WAN and SASE.
Experience with Firewalls (Palo Alto preferred).

cond_0177.intro: The Network Analyst role is to ensure the stability and integrity of the university's network. This is achieved by regularly working with others on the planning, designing, and developing of LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP across the organization. The Analyst will also take part in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network and telecommunication hardware, software, and communication links, and will work closely with colleagues to analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion. Off-hour and weekend work will be required to respond to critical network problems and modifications. The position reports to the Manager of Network and Telecommunication Services.
cond_0177.responsibilities:
Ensure network stability and monitor the network regularly, staying in contact with the team to flag issues early.
Prepare and maintain networking documentation, network and cabling layouts.
Troubleshoot and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VOIP and VPN related problems, communicating progress and outcomes to relevant colleagues.
Cooperate with management to develop staff and improve their skills.
Respond to Help Desk telephone calls, emails, and personnel requests for technical support in a timely and courteous manner, handling questions directly and professionally.
Maintain an inventory of network and telecommunication property and assets.
Provide technical support and monitor day-to-day operations of the network infrastructure.
Maintain quality service by following organization standards.
Report on network operational status by gathering and prioritizing information and managing projects.
Analyze university needs regarding use of network and telecommunication equipment and services, and provide planning, leadership, direction, and technical expertise to the campus on LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP services.
Actively contribute to strategic and long-range planning for campus network and telecommunication services.
Keep the Manager updated with regular progress reports on assigned tasks, projects and break/fix problems; speak up early about any problems encountered or anticipated and keep the Manager informed of estimated completion times.
Maintain current knowledge of relevant technology, equipment and systems.
Provide technical oversight, assignment, supervision, and review of work performed by student employees.
Work with internal customers and external suppliers on an ongoing basis.
Actively participate in technical group discussions and presentations.
Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.

This is achieved by assisting in the planning, designing, and developing LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP across the organization. In addition, the Analyst will participate with the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network / telecommunication hardware, software, and communication links. This individual will also analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion. The position reports to the Manager of Network and Telecommunication Services. Specific responsibilities include accountability for the following groups/areas:
cond_0236.responsibilities:
Ensure network stability and monitor network regularly.
Prepare and maintain networking documentation network and cabling layouts.
Troubleshoot and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VOIP and VPN related problems.
Cooperate with management to develop staff and improve their skills.
Respond to Help Desk telephone calls, emails, and personnel requests for technical support in a timely and courteous manner.
Maintain an inventory of network /telecommunication property and assets.
Provide technical support and monitors day to day operations of the network infrastructure.
Maintain quality service by following organization standards.
Report on network operational status by gathering, prioritizing information; managing projects.
Analyzes university needs regarding use of network and telecommunication equipment and services, and provides planning, leadership, direction, and technical expertise to the campus on LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP services.
Participates in strategic and long-range planning for campus network and telecommunication services.
Provides Manager with appropriate updates detailing progress made on assigned tasks, projects and break/fix problems.
Notify manager of any problems encountered or anticipated with the tasks assigned and keeps manager informed of the estimated time required to complete each task.
Maintains currency of knowledge with respect to relevant state-of-the-art technology, equipment and/or systems.
Provides technical oversight and assignment, supervision, and review of work performed by student employees.
Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Works with internal customers and external suppliers.
Participates in technical group discussions and presentations.
cond_0236.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate degree or 2–5 years of demonstrated expertise in networking and telecommunication, or equivalent combination of experience.
Advanced knowledge of fundamental principles, methodologies and procedures utilized in administering and monitoring network and telecommunication procedures.
Proven track record in network, systems and data security; deep knowledge of various security tools and equipment used to secure networks, servers, and data; demonstrated expertise in following standards and processes for a secure computing environment.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, problem solving ability, interpersonal skills, presentation skills, and strong command of software tools to develop effective and professional documents.
Ability to maintain confidential data in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in management information systems, computer technology, computer science or related field strongly preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to work with people at all levels of the organization, manage multiple initiatives with deadlines, respond quickly to changing situations and maintain individual and team effectiveness under pressure.
Strong commitment to working as a contributing member of the team including other systems personnel, the operations staff, and the account administrators.
Proficiency in Routing and Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRFs, etc.)
Proficiency in Switching (VLANs, Trunking, Spanning Tree, etc.)
Expertise in Aruba Wireless Network
Solid understanding of VoIP/SIP
Solid understanding of SD-WAN

cond_0252.intro: The Network Analyst role is to help ensure the stability and integrity of the university's network. This is achieved by working with the team on planning, designing, and developing LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP across the organization. In addition, the Analyst will participate with the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network / telecommunication hardware, software, and communication links. This individual will also work with colleagues to analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion. Off-hour and weekend work will be required to respond to critical network problems and modifications. The position reports to the Manager of Network and Telecommunication Services.
cond_0252.responsibilities:
Ensure network stability and monitor network regularly.
Prepare and maintain networking documentation, network and cabling layouts.
Coordinate with colleagues to troubleshoot and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VOIP and VPN related problems.
Work with management to develop staff and improve their skills.
Respond to Help Desk telephone calls, emails, and personnel requests for technical support in a timely and courteous manner.
Maintain an inventory of network/telecommunication property and assets.
Provide technical support and help monitor day to day operations of the network infrastructure.
Maintain quality service by following organization standards.
Share network operational status updates by gathering and prioritizing information; coordinating on projects.
Work alongside the team to assess university needs regarding use of network and telecommunication equipment and services, and contribute planning, direction, and technical expertise on LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP services.
Participate in strategic and long-range planning for campus network and telecommunication services.
Keep the Manager informed with appropriate updates detailing progress made on assigned tasks, projects and break/fix problems.
Notify manager of any problems encountered or anticipated with the tasks assigned and keep manager informed of the estimated time required to complete each task.
Maintain currency of knowledge with respect to relevant state-of-the-art technology, equipment and/or systems.
Coordinate technical oversight and review of work performed by student employees.
Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Work with internal customers and external suppliers.
Participate in technical group discussions and presentations.
cond_0252.requirements:
Associate degree is required or 2-5 years of experience in networking and telecommunication, or any equivalent combination of experience; Bachelor's degree is a plus.
Technical degree in management information systems, computer technology, computer science or related field preferred.
Knowledge of fundamental principles, methodologies and procedures utilized in administering and monitoring network and telecommunication procedures.
Experience in network, systems and data security is required; knowledge of various security tools and equipment used to secure networks, servers, and data is required; proven experience in following standards and processes for a secure computing environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, problem solving ability, interpersonal skills, presentation skills, and the ability to use software tools to develop effective and professional documents required.
Must be able to work with people at all levels of the organization, manage multiple initiatives with deadlines, respond quickly to new changing situations and work well under pressure while maintaining individual and team effectiveness.
Ability to maintain confidential data in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Willingness to work as a contributing member of the team including other systems personnel, the operations staff, and the account administrators.
Knowledge of Routing and Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRFs, etc.)
Knowledge of Switching (VLANs, Trunking, Spanning Tree, etc.)
Knowledge of Aruba Wireless Network
Knowledge of VoIP/SIP
Knowledge of SD-WAN
Knowledge of SASE
Knowledge of Firewalls (Palo Alto preferred)

cond_0380.intro: The Network Analyst role is to ensure the stability and integrity of the university's network. This is achieved by assisting in the planning, designing, and developing LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP across the organization. In addition, the Analyst will participate with the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network / telecommunication hardware, software, and communication links. This individual will also analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion. The position reports to the Manager of Network and Telecommunication Services. Specific responsibilities include accountability for the following groups/areas:
cond_0380.responsibilities:
Ensure network stability and monitor network regularly.
Prepare and maintain networking documentation network and cabling layouts.
Troubleshoot and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VOIP and VPN related problems.
Cooperate with management to develop staff and improve their skills.
Respond to Help Desk telephone calls, emails, and personnel requests for technical support in a timely and courteous manner.
Maintain an inventory of network /telecommunication property and assets.
Provide technical support and monitors day to day operations of the network infrastructure.
Maintain quality service by following organization standards.
Report on network operational status by gathering, prioritizing information; managing projects.
Analyzes university needs regarding use of network and telecommunication equipment and services, and provides planning, leadership, direction, and technical expertise to the campus on LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP services.
Participates in strategic and long-range planning for campus network and telecommunication services.
Provides Manager with appropriate updates detailing progress made on assigned tasks, projects and break/fix problems.
Notify manager of any problems encountered or anticipated with the tasks assigned and keeps manager informed of the estimated time required to complete each task.
Maintains currency of knowledge with respect to relevant state-of-the-art technology, equipment and/or systems.
Provides technical oversight and assignment, supervision, and review of work performed by student employees.
Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Works with internal customers and external suppliers.
Participates in technical group discussions and presentations.
cond_0380.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate degree or 2–5 years of demonstrated expertise in networking and telecommunication, or equivalent combination of experience.
Advanced knowledge of fundamental principles, methodologies and procedures utilized in administering and monitoring network and telecommunication procedures.
Proven track record in network, systems and data security; deep knowledge of various security tools and equipment used to secure networks, servers, and data; demonstrated expertise in following standards and processes for a secure computing environment.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, problem solving ability, interpersonal skills, presentation skills, and strong command of software tools to develop effective and professional documents.
Ability to maintain confidential data in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in management information systems, computer technology, computer science or related field strongly preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to work with people at all levels of the organization, manage multiple initiatives with deadlines, respond quickly to changing situations and maintain individual and team effectiveness under pressure.
Strong commitment to working as a contributing member of the team including other systems personnel, the operations staff, and the account administrators.
Proficiency in Routing and Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRFs, etc.)
Proficiency in Switching (VLANs, Trunking, Spanning Tree, etc.)
Expertise in Aruba Wireless Network
Solid understanding of VoIP/SIP
Solid understanding of SD-WAN
Solid understanding of SASE
Expertise in Firewalls (Palo Alto preferred)

cond_0440.intro: The Network Analyst is responsible for ensuring the stability and integrity of the university's network. You will take ownership of planning, designing, and developing LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and VOIP across the organization. You will also lead the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network and telecommunication hardware, software, and communication links, and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate manner. Off-hour and weekend work will be required to respond to critical network problems and modifications. The position reports to the Manager of Network and Telecommunication Services.
cond_0440.responsibilities:
Ensure network stability and monitor the network regularly.
Prepare and maintain networking documentation, network and cabling layouts.
Troubleshoot and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VOIP, and VPN related problems.
Drive staff development in coordination with management to improve team skills.
Respond to Help Desk calls, emails, and personnel requests for technical support in a timely and courteous manner.
Maintain an inventory of network and telecommunication property and assets.
Deliver technical support and oversee day-to-day operations of the network infrastructure.
Maintain quality service by following organization standards.
Report on network operational status by gathering and prioritizing information and managing projects.
Analyze university needs regarding network and telecommunication equipment and services, and provide planning, direction, and technical expertise on LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and VOIP services.
Lead participation in strategic and long-range planning for campus network and telecommunication services.
Keep the Manager informed with updates on assigned tasks, projects, and break/fix problems, including any issues encountered and estimated completion times.
Maintain current knowledge of relevant technology, equipment, and systems.
Provide technical oversight, assignment, supervision, and review of work performed by student employees.
Manage coordination with internal customers and external suppliers.
Lead and contribute to technical group discussions and presentations.
Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
cond_0440.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate degree or 2–5 years of experience in networking and telecommunications, or an equivalent combination.
Knowledge of fundamental principles, methodologies, and procedures used in administering and monitoring network and telecommunication systems.
Experience in network, systems, and data security; knowledge of security tools and equipment used to secure networks, servers, and data; proven experience following standards and processes for a secure computing environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, problem-solving ability, interpersonal skills, presentation skills, and ability to use software tools to develop professional documents.
Ability to work with people at all levels of the organization, manage multiple initiatives with deadlines, respond quickly to changing situations, and work well under pressure.
Ability to maintain confidential data in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Willingness to work as a contributing member of the team, including systems personnel, operations staff, and account administrators.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree is a plus.
Technical degree in management information systems, computer technology, computer science, or a related field.
Knowledge of routing and routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRFs, etc.).
Knowledge of switching (VLANs, Trunking, Spanning Tree, etc.).
Familiarity with Aruba Wireless Network.
Experience with VoIP/SIP, SD-WAN, and SASE.
Experience with firewalls, Palo Alto preferred.

The Analyst will actively participate in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network and telecommunication hardware, software, and communication links, and will work directly with others to analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion. Off-hour and weekend work will be required to respond to critical network problems and modifications. The position reports to the Manager of Network and Telecommunication Services.
cond_0456.responsibilities:
Ensure network stability and regularly monitor the network.
Prepare and maintain networking documentation, network and cabling layouts.
Troubleshoot and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VOIP and VPN related problems.
Work closely with management to develop staff and improve their skills.
Respond to Help Desk telephone calls, emails, and personnel requests for technical support in a timely and courteous manner, staying in regular contact with internal customers.
Maintain an inventory of network and telecommunication property and assets.
Provide technical support and monitor day to day operations of the network infrastructure.
Maintain quality service by following organization standards.
Report on network operational status by gathering and prioritizing information and managing projects.
Actively engage with university stakeholders to analyze needs regarding use of network and telecommunication equipment and services, and provide planning, leadership, direction, and technical expertise on LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP services.
Participate in strategic and long-range planning for campus network and telecommunication services.
Keep the Manager updated with regular progress reports on assigned tasks, projects and break/fix problems; proactively raise any problems encountered or anticipated and communicate estimated completion times.
Maintain current knowledge of relevant technology, equipment and systems.
Provide technical oversight, assignment, supervision, and review of work performed by student employees.
Work with internal customers and external suppliers on an ongoing basis.
Actively contribute to technical group discussions and presentations.
Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
cond_0456.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate degree or 2–5 years of experience in networking and telecommunication, or any equivalent combination of experience.
Knowledge of fundamental principles, methodologies and procedures used in administering and monitoring network and telecommunication systems.
Experience in network, systems and data security; knowledge of various security tools and equipment used to secure networks, servers, and data; proven experience following standards and processes for a secure computing environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, problem solving ability, interpersonal skills, presentation skills, and the ability to use software tools to develop effective and professional documents.
Ability to work with people at all levels of the organization, manage multiple initiatives with deadlines, respond quickly to changing situations, and work well under pressure while maintaining individual and team effectiveness.
Ability to maintain confidential data in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Willingness to work as a contributing member of the team, including other systems personnel, operations staff, and account administrators.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree.
Technical degree in management information systems, computer technology, computer science or related field.
Knowledge of Routing and Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRFs, etc.).
Knowledge of Switching (VLANs, Trunking, Spanning Tree, etc.).
Aruba Wireless Network experience.
VoIP/SIP experience.
SD-WAN and SASE knowledge.
Firewall experience, Palo Alto preferred.

The Analyst will also take part in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network and telecommunication hardware, software, and communication links, and will work closely with colleagues to analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion. Off-hour and weekend work will be required to respond to critical network problems and modifications. The position reports to the Manager of Network and Telecommunication Services.
cond_0573.responsibilities:
Ensure network stability and monitor the network regularly, staying in contact with the team to flag issues early.
Prepare and maintain networking documentation, network and cabling layouts.
Troubleshoot and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VOIP and VPN related problems, communicating progress and outcomes to relevant colleagues.
Cooperate with management to develop staff and improve their skills.
Respond to Help Desk telephone calls, emails, and personnel requests for technical support in a timely and courteous manner, handling questions directly and professionally.
Maintain an inventory of network and telecommunication property and assets.
Provide technical support and monitor day-to-day operations of the network infrastructure.
Maintain quality service by following organization standards.
Report on network operational status by gathering and prioritizing information and managing projects.
Analyze university needs regarding use of network and telecommunication equipment and services, and provide planning, leadership, direction, and technical expertise to the campus on LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and VOIP services.
Actively contribute to strategic and long-range planning for campus network and telecommunication services.
Keep the Manager updated with regular progress reports on assigned tasks, projects and break/fix problems; speak up early about any problems encountered or anticipated and keep the Manager informed of estimated completion times.
Maintain current knowledge of relevant technology, equipment and systems.
Provide technical oversight, assignment, supervision, and review of work performed by student employees.
Work with internal customers and external suppliers on an ongoing basis.
Actively participate in technical group discussions and presentations.
Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
cond_0573.requirements:
Associate degree or 2–5 years of experience in networking and telecommunication, or any equivalent combination of experience; Bachelor's degree is a plus.
Technical degree in management information systems, computer technology, computer science or related field preferred.
Knowledge of fundamental principles, methodologies and procedures used in administering and monitoring network and telecommunication procedures.
Experience in network, systems and data security is required; knowledge of various security tools and equipment used to secure networks, servers, and data is required; proven experience following standards and processes for a secure computing environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, problem solving ability, interpersonal skills, presentation skills, and the ability to use software tools to develop effective and professional documents.
Must be able to work with people at all levels of the organization, manage multiple initiatives with deadlines, respond quickly to changing situations and work well under pressure while maintaining individual and team effectiveness.
Ability to maintain confidential data in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Willingness to work as a contributing member of the team including other systems personnel, the operations staff, and the account administrators.
Knowledge of Routing and Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRFs, etc.).
Knowledge of Switching (VLANs, Trunking, Spanning Tree, etc.).
Knowledge of Aruba Wireless Network.
Knowledge of VoIP/SIP.
Knowledge of SD-WAN.
Knowledge of SASE.
Knowledge of Firewalls (Palo Alto preferred).
